# EOM — Eye On Metadata

> Free, open-source desktop tool to inspect, export, and strip file metadata.
> Local-only. No upload. No account. No cloud.

## What it does

EOM lets you see what your files are hiding. It reads, exports, and removes
metadata embedded in images, audio, video, and document files — entirely on
your machine.

## Core features

- **Extract** — Read EXIF, XMP, IPTC (images), ID3 (audio), and PDF metadata
- **Remove** — Strip tags in place or write a clean copy
- **Export** — Save metadata as JSON, CSV, or plain text
- **ExifTool support** — Automatically uses ExifTool when installed for broader coverage

## Supported formats

| Category  | Formats                                      |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------|
| Images    | JPEG, PNG, TIFF                              |
| Audio     | MP3, FLAC, OGG, WAV, AIFF, M4A, WMA         |
| Video     | MP4, MKV, WebM                               |
| Documents | PDF                                          |

## How it works

EOM is a native desktop application. Files are processed locally — nothing
leaves your computer. No server, no telemetry, no internet connection required.

## Pricing & license

Free. Open source (MIT). Version 1.0.

Available for Linux, Windows, and macOS.
